## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle late-Míng abridged commentary on the *Mùlián wǔbǎiwèn jīng* ([KR6k0073](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0073)) by **Xìng Qí** 性祇 ([性祇](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%80%A7%E7%A5%87)). The commentary glosses the casuistic Vinaya questions of the parent sūtra, explaining the Buddha's adjudications and relating them to standard Vinaya doctrine.

**Abstract**

Xìng Qí's commentary is one of two late-Míng treatments of the *Mùlián wǔbǎiwèn* casuistic literature (the other being [永海](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B0%B8%E6%B5%B7) Yǒng Hǎi's [KR6k0075](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0075)). The two commentaries reflect the late-Míng Vinaya revival under figures like [袾宏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%A2%BE%E5%AE%8F) Yúnqī Zhūhóng 雲棲袾宏 and [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) Ǒuyì Zhìxù 蕅益智旭 — a movement to recover practical Vinaya scholarship after the long Míng decline of monastic discipline.
